name: bridge pose setu bandhasana
description: A yoga backbend that strengthens the glutes and opens the chest and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body, palms down.
Press through your feet and lift your hips.
Roll your shoulders under and lengthen your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
